propositions: Store-level project-to-repos mapping must be persisted in .bridge_state/projects.json with version and legacy_default fields to prevent diff conflicts when multiple repos fetch different project subsets against a shared snapshot

CLI subcommands bridge projects list/set/remove, library functions load_mapping/resolve_project, and MCP tools (list as READ_ONLY read tool, set/remove as write tools) must all operate on the same projects.json record with byte-identical persistence
resolve_project must implement tri-state logic: returning legacy_default for absent ticket field, None for explicit empty string, the project key for set values, and None when legacy_default is empty
set command without --repos argument must error with non-zero exit; set --repos empty-string must store empty array []
set on existing key must replace repos list idempotently, not merge; remove of unknown key must exit non-zero without mutation
projects.json write operations must not alter bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json; bridge group help text in bridge.txt and argparse metavar must both reference projects verb
